summary: Rio Branco's municipal Cadastro Imobiliário custodian and official RBGeo Lotes Cadastro Imobiliário - 2023 polygon layer were evidenced. The layer schema and CRS were readable, but the bounded anonymous exact-point feature request was inaccessible/backend-unavailable, so no parcel sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: English and Portuguese first-party discovery queries, exact text, outcomes and actual URLs are recorded in city-196-rio-branco.json.
requestOutcomes: The official layer directory and query form were readable. The JSON metadata route returned a backend connection-refused error; the exact-point GeoJSON query was inaccessible; the related map service metadata route returned a cache miss. No credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe fields or TLS exception were used.
scopeLimits: Local municipal cadastral custodianship is evidenced, but complete Rio Branco city coverage was not established.
The exact-point request failure was not treated as a hit or miss and does not support an absence claim.
No parcel geometry was returned in a verified Rio Branco feature response, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
The layer's id and fid fields were documented as candidates only; no feature-level stable identity was verified.
Packet completion does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter.
nativeIdentityPolicy: The official layer exposes id, fid, and cadastral grouping fields, but no returned feature was available to confirm a stable native identity. No identity was retained.
crs: The Lotes layer declares EPSG:3857; the related Imóveis_com_geo service declares EPSG:31979. No retained geometry was available for independent transformation validation.
geometryQuality: not applicable; no verified Rio Branco geometry retrieved

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: attempted with exact WUP point; inaccessible/backend-unavailable, no hit/miss inference
